+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""wakeword.py — 离线语音唤醒：听到唤醒词自动触发语音助手。
+
+为什么用本地模型而不是云端：
+  唤醒要一直听，云端 ASR 一次要 1~2 秒还要走网络；本地小模型几十~几百毫秒
+  就出结果，而且待机时完全不消耗云端额度、不依赖网络。
+
+麦克风独占问题（关键）：
+  ALSA 的采集设备是独占的 —— 唤醒引擎拿着麦克风，语音助手就录不了音。
+  所以检测到唤醒词后，本程序**先关掉麦克风**，再触发助手，然后等助手
+  录完（靠监视 arecord 进程）才重新接管麦克风。
+
+用法：
+    python3 wakeword.py                        # 默认唤醒词
+    python3 wakeword.py --keywords 你好小车,小车小车
+    python3 wakeword.py --fifo /tmp/voice_trigger
+
+配套：语音助手要用 FIFO 触发启动
+    bash 语音助手.sh   # 脚本里已是 --trigger fifo
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+MIC_DEFAULT = "plughw:CARD=hobotsnd5,DEV=0"
+RATE = 16000
+CHUNK = 4000          # 0.125 秒 @16k/16bit
+
+
+def log(msg):
+    print("[%s] %s" % (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), msg), flush=True)
+
+
+def assistant_busy() -> bool:
+    """助手是否正在录音（它用 arecord 采集）。"""
+    try:
+        r = subprocess.run(["pgrep", "-f", "arecord"], capture_output=True)
+        return r.returncode == 0
+    except Exception:
+        return False
+
+
+def trigger(fifo: str) -> bool:
+    """往助手的 FIFO 写一个字节，等于"按了一次键"。"""
+    try:
+        fd = os.open(fifo, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_NONBLOCK)
+        try:
+            os.write(fd, b"x")
+        finally:
+            os.close(fd)
+        return True
+    except OSError as exc:
+        log("触发失败（助手在跑吗？FIFO=%s）：%s" % (fifo, exc))
+        return False
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="离线唤醒词")
+    ap.add_argument("--model", default=os.path.expanduser(
+        "~/vosk-model-small-cn-0.22"))
+    ap.add_argument("--mic", default=MIC_DEFAULT)
+    ap.add_argument("--fifo", default="/tmp/voice_trigger")
+    ap.add_argument("--keywords", default="小车小车,你好小车,小车你好,你好小車")
+    ap.add_argument("--cooldown", type=float, default=2.0,
+                    help="触发后的冷却秒数，防止连触发")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    keys = [k.strip() for k in args.keywords.replace("，", ",").split(",") if k.strip()]
+
+    try:
+        from vosk import Model, KaldiRecognizer, SetLogLevel
+    except ImportError:
+        log("没有 vosk：先 python3 -m pip install --user vosk")
+        return 2
+    SetLogLevel(-1)
+
+    if not os.path.isdir(args.model):
+        log("找不到模型目录：%s" % args.model)
+        return 2
+    log("加载模型 %s …" % os.path.basename(args.model))
+    model = Model(args.model)
+    log("模型就绪。唤醒词：%s" % " / ".join(keys))
+    log("（对着板子说唤醒词即可，无需按键）")
+
+    last_fire = 0.0
+    while True:
+        # 助手在用麦克风时等着，别去抢
+        if assistant_busy():
+            time.sleep(0.4)
+            continue
+
+        proc = subprocess.Popen(
+            ["arecord", "-D", args.mic, "-r", str(RATE), "-c", "1",
+             "-f", "S16_LE", "-t", "raw", "-q"],
+            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, bufsize=0)
+        rec = KaldiRecognizer(model, RATE)
+        log("开始监听…")
+        try:
+            while True:
+                data = proc.stdout.read(CHUNK)
+                if not data:
+                    break
+                text = ""
+                if rec.AcceptWaveform(data):
+                    import json as _json
+                    text = _json.loads(rec.Result()).get("text", "")
+                else:
+                    import json as _json
+                    text = _json.loads(rec.PartialResult()).get("partial", "")
+                if not text:
+                    continue
+                hit = next((k for k in keys if k in text.replace(" ", "")), None)
+                if hit and time.time() - last_fire > args.cooldown:
+                    last_fire = time.time()
+                    log("🎤 听到唤醒词「%s」（识别到：%s）" % (hit, text))
+                    break
+        except KeyboardInterrupt:
+            proc.terminate()
+            raise
+        finally:
+            # 先放开麦克风，再触发助手
+            try:
+                proc.terminate()
+                proc.wait(timeout=3)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+
+        trigger(args.fifo)
+        log("已触发语音助手，等它录完…")
+        time.sleep(1.0)
+        # 等助手这一轮结束（它录音时会跑 arecord）
+        t0 = time.time()
+        while assistant_busy() or time.time() - t0 < 6:
+            if time.time() - t0 > 60:
+                break
+            if not assistant_busy() and time.time() - t0 > 6:
+                break
+            time.sleep(0.3)
+        time.sleep(0.5)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        sys.exit(main())
+    except KeyboardInterrupt:
+        print()
*** End Patch

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""实测唤醒词识别：录 6 秒，交给 Vosk 识别，打印结果。"""
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+MIC = "plughw:CARD=hobotsnd5,DEV=0"
+RATE = 16000
+SECONDS = 6
+KEYS = ["小陈同志", "小陈"]
+
+from vosk import Model, KaldiRecognizer, SetLogLevel  # noqa: E402
+
+SetLogLevel(-1)
+t0 = time.time()
+model = Model("/home/sunrise/vosk-model-small-cn-0.22")
+print("模型加载耗时 %.1f 秒" % (time.time() - t0))
+
+print("请对着板子说：「小陈同志」（%d 秒内）…" % SECONDS)
+proc = subprocess.Popen(["arecord", "-D", MIC, "-r", str(RATE), "-c", "1",
+                         "-f", "S16_LE", "-t", "raw", "-q"],
+                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, bufsize=0)
+rec = KaldiRecognizer(model, RATE)
+texts = []
+t0 = time.time()
+while time.time() - t0 < SECONDS:
+    data = proc.stdout.read(4000)
+    if not data:
+        break
+    if rec.AcceptWaveform(data):
+        texts.append(json.loads(rec.Result()).get("text", ""))
+    else:
+        p = json.loads(rec.PartialResult()).get("partial", "")
+        if p:
+            texts.append("~" + p)
+proc.terminate()
+texts.append(json.loads(rec.FinalResult()).get("text", ""))
+
+print()
+print("识别到的内容：")
+for t in texts:
+    if t:
+        print("   ", t)
+joined = "".join(texts).replace(" ", "")
+hit = next((k for k in KEYS if k in joined), None)
+print()
+print("命中唤醒词：%s" % (hit or "无"))
+print()
+print("耗时参考：单次识别约 %.1f 秒（%.0f 秒音频）"
+      % (time.time() - t0, SECONDS))
*** End Patch

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 语音助手.sh -- 一键启动按键语音交互（替代 S1 按键板的方案）
#
# 用法（在 VNC 桌面的终端里运行）：
#   bash ~/voice_pipeline/语音助手.sh            # 常驻：每按一次 Enter 说一句
#   bash ~/voice_pipeline/语音助手.sh --once     # 只说一句就退出
#
# 交互：
#   按 Enter  -> 响一声提示音，开始录音；说完自动结束并响第二声
#   输入 q     -> 退出
#   Ctrl-C    -> 退出
#
# 为什么用终端按键代替 S1 按键板：
#   1) S1 板（HT16K33，i2c-5，地址 0x74~0x77）实测始终无法被识别（厂测工具也报
#      "S1 are needed."），已放弃
#   2) 从 Windows 经 VNC 操作时，按键走 x11vnc 的 XTEST 注入，**不会**进入
#      /dev/input/event*，所以 evdev 方案在 VNC 下不可用（已实测确认）
#   3) 终端输入走 PTY，**VNC 下完全可用**，且零硬件、零 root

set -uo pipefail
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$HOME"

# 载入板子代理设置（由桌面「启用代理」按钮生成；文件不存在则自动忽略）
[ -r /etc/x3m-proxy.env ] && . /etc/x3m-proxy.env

export CAR_IP="${CAR_IP:-192.168.1.204}"   # 小车4（rosbridge）

# 云端优先：录音 -> 云端识别 -> 云端模型理解意图 -> 转成指令下发给小车
# 触发方式：FIFO。语音唤醒程序（wakeword.py）检测到唤醒词后往这个 FIFO
# 写一个字节，等价于"按了一次键"。手动触发也是同一句话：
#     echo x > /tmp/voice_trigger
OPTS=("--trigger" "fifo" "--fifo" "/tmp/voice_trigger"
      "--agent-backend" "command"
      "--agent-cmd" "python3 $HERE/llm_intent.py"
      "--cloud-first"
      "--vcmd-exec"
      "--tts"
      "--tts-prompt")
# 说明：
#   --agent-cmd  指向 llm_intent.py —— 它把提示词交给 DeepSeek，返回结构化意图
#   --cloud-first 整句交给云端模型理解（急停等安全指令仍由本地规则确定性处理）
#   --vcmd-exec  让 vcmd 真正下发命令；不加的话只打印不执行
if [ "${1:-}" = "--once" ]; then
  OPTS+=("--once")
fi

# 若在图形界面里启动，自动打开一个终端窗口（方便直接看到提示）
if [ -z "${DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
  echo "提示：没有 DISPLAY，直接在当前终端运行。"
fi

echo "=============================================="
echo " 语音助手已启动"
echo "   按 Enter 开始一轮（提示音 → 录音 → 识别 → 回灌）"
echo "   输入 q 退出"
echo "=============================================="
echo

exec python3 "$HERE/voice_button.py" "${OPTS[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""实测唤醒词识别：录 6 秒，交给 Vosk 识别，打印结果。"""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time

MIC = "plughw:CARD=hobotsnd5,DEV=0"
RATE = 16000
SECONDS = 6
KEYS = ["小陈同志", "小陈"]

from vosk import Model, KaldiRecognizer, SetLogLevel  # noqa: E402

SetLogLevel(-1)
t0 = time.time()
model = Model("/home/sunrise/vosk-model-small-cn-0.22")
print("模型加载耗时 %.1f 秒" % (time.time() - t0))

print("请对着板子说：「小陈同志」（%d 秒内）…" % SECONDS)
proc = subprocess.Popen(["arecord", "-D", MIC, "-r", str(RATE), "-c", "1",
                         "-f", "S16_LE", "-t", "raw", "-q"],
                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, bufsize=0)
rec = KaldiRecognizer(model, RATE)
texts = []
t0 = time.time()
while time.time() - t0 < SECONDS:
    data = proc.stdout.read(4000)
    if not data:
        break
    if rec.AcceptWaveform(data):
        texts.append(json.loads(rec.Result()).get("text", ""))
    else:
        p = json.loads(rec.PartialResult()).get("partial", "")
        if p:
            texts.append("~" + p)
proc.terminate()
texts.append(json.loads(rec.FinalResult()).get("text", ""))

print()
print("识别到的内容：")
for t in texts:
    if t:
        print("   ", t)
joined = "".join(texts).replace(" ", "")
hit = next((k for k in KEYS if k in joined), None)
print()
print("命中唤醒词：%s" % (hit or "无"))
print()
print("耗时参考：单次识别约 %.1f 秒（%.0f 秒音频）"
      % (time.time() - t0, SECONDS))

  ALSA 的采集设备是独占的 —— 唤醒引擎拿着麦克风，语音助手就录不了音。
  所以检测到唤醒词后，本程序**先关掉麦克风**，再触发助手，然后等助手
  录完（靠监视 arecord 进程）才重新接管麦克风。

用法：
    python3 wakeword.py                        # 默认唤醒词
    python3 wakeword.py --keywords 你好小车,小车小车
    python3 wakeword.py --fifo /tmp/voice_trigger

配套：语音助手要用 FIFO 触发启动
    bash 语音助手.sh   # 脚本里已是 --trigger fifo
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

MIC_DEFAULT = "plughw:CARD=hobotsnd5,DEV=0"
RATE = 16000
CHUNK = 4000          # 0.125 秒 @16k/16bit


def log(msg):
    print("[%s] %s" % (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), msg), flush=True)


def assistant_busy() -> bool:
    """助手是否正在录音（它用 arecord 采集）。"""
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(["pgrep", "-f", "arecord"], capture_output=True)
        return r.returncode == 0
    except Exception:
        return False


def trigger(fifo: str) -> bool:
    """往助手的 FIFO 写一个字节，等于"按了一次键"。"""
    try:
        fd = os.open(fifo, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_NONBLOCK)
        try:
            os.write(fd, b"x")
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        return True
    except OSError as exc:
        log("触发失败（助手在跑吗？FIFO=%s）：%s" % (fifo, exc))
        return False


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="离线唤醒词")
    ap.add_argument("--model", default=os.path.expanduser(
        "~/vosk-model-small-cn-0.22"))
    ap.add_argument("--mic", default=MIC_DEFAULT)
    ap.add_argument("--fifo", default="/tmp/voice_trigger")
    # 唤醒词。人名类唤醒词小模型容易听错（"小陈同志"可能被识别成
    # "小陈通知/小陈统计"），所以除了原词还带上特征词"小陈"做容错 ——
    # 只要听出"小陈"就唤醒，漏唤醒少很多，也不会被普通聊天误触发。
    ap.add_argument("--keywords", default="小陈同志,小陈")
    ap.add_argument("--cooldown", type=float, default=2.0,
                    help="触发后的冷却秒数，防止连触发")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    keys = [k.strip() for k in args.keywords.replace("，", ",").split(",") if k.strip()]

    try:
        from vosk import Model, KaldiRecognizer, SetLogLevel
    except ImportError:
        log("没有 vosk：先 python3 -m pip install --user vosk")
        return 2
    SetLogLevel(-1)

    if not os.path.isdir(args.model):
        log("找不到模型目录：%s" % args.model)
        return 2
    log("加载模型 %s …" % os.path.basename(args.model))
    model = Model(args.model)
    log("模型就绪。唤醒词：%s" % " / ".join(keys))
    log("（对着板子说唤醒词即可，无需按键）")

    last_fire = 0.0
    while True:
        # 助手在用麦克风时等着，别去抢
        if assistant_busy():
            time.sleep(0.4)
            continue

        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            ["arecord", "-D", args.mic, "-r", str(RATE), "-c", "1",
             "-f", "S16_LE", "-t", "raw", "-q"],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, bufsize=0)
        rec = KaldiRecognizer(model, RATE)
        log("开始监听…")
        try:
            while True:
                data = proc.stdout.read(CHUNK)
                if not data:
                    break
                text = ""
                if rec.AcceptWaveform(data):
                    import json as _json
                    text = _json.loads(rec.Result()).get("text", "")
                else:
                    import json as _json
                    text = _json.loads(rec.PartialResult()).get("partial", "")
                if not text:
                    continue
                hit = next((k for k in keys if k in text.replace(" ", "")), None)
                if hit and time.time() - last_fire > args.cooldown:
                    last_fire = time.time()
                    log("🎤 听到唤醒词「%s」（识别到：%s）" % (hit, text))
                    break
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            proc.terminate()
            raise
        finally:
            # 先放开麦克风，再触发助手
            try:
                proc.terminate()
                proc.wait(timeout=3)
            except Exception:
                pass

        trigger(args.fifo)
        log("已触发语音助手，等它录完…")
        time.sleep(1.0)
        # 等助手这一轮结束（它录音时会跑 arecord）
        t0 = time.time()
        while assistant_busy() or time.time() - t0 < 6:
            if time.time() - t0 > 60:
                break
            if not assistant_busy() and time.time() - t0 > 6:
                break
            time.sleep(0.3)
        time.sleep(0.5)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""tts.py — 文字转语音并从这个板子的扬声器播出来。

设计要点：
  1. **本地缓存**：同一句话只调一次云端，之后直接播缓存。固定话术（"好的"、
     "完成"、"没听懂"）第一次之后就是零延迟。
  2. **不阻塞可选**：说一句话默认等它播完，但调用方可以后台播。
  3. **失败不致命**：TTS 挂掉只警告，绝不影响主流程（下指令本身）。

用法：
    python3 tts.py "好的，前进半米"
    python3 tts.py --list                 # 看缓存了哪些
    python3 tts.py --presynth "好的,完成,没听懂"   # 预合成固定话术

依赖：aplay（板子已有）、网络（走 /etc/x3m-proxy.env 里的代理）
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
import wave

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CACHE_DIR = HERE / "tts_cache"

SPK_DEV = "plughw:CARD=hobotsnd5,DEV=1"
API_URL = ("https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/api/v1/services/aigc/"
           "multimodal-generation/generation")
DEFAULT_VOICE = "Cherry"
TIMEOUT = 45


def api_key() -> str:
    for name in ("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY", "QWEN_TTS_API_KEY"):
        v = (os.environ.get(name) or "").strip()
        if v:
            return v
    cfg = pathlib.Path.home() / ".codex" / "qwen-asr.json"
    try:
        return str(json.loads(cfg.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("api_key", ""))
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return ""


def cache_path(text: str, voice: str) -> pathlib.Path:
    h = hashlib.sha256(("%s|%s" % (voice, text)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
    return CACHE_DIR / ("%s.wav" % h)


def synth(text: str, voice: str = DEFAULT_VOICE) -> pathlib.Path:
    """合成一句话，返回 wav 路径（命中缓存就直接返回）。"""
    CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dst = cache_path(text, voice)
    if dst.is_file() and dst.stat().st_size > 1000:
        return dst

    key = api_key()
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError("找不到 DashScope API key（~/.codex/qwen-asr.json）")

    body = json.dumps({
        "model": "qwen-tts",
        "input": {"text": text, "voice": voice},
    }, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        API_URL, data=body,
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + key,
                 "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=TIMEOUT) as r:

            if skip > 0:

+"""唤醒命中率实测：同一段「小陈同志」音频连播 N 次，统计 Vosk 认出几次。

+
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys

+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/home/sunrise/voice_pipeline")
+

+    model = Model(MODEL_DIR)
+
+    try:

+
+    rec = subprocess.Popen(

+         "-t", "raw", "-q", RAW],

+        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
+    time.sleep(1.5)
+

+        time.sleep(gap)
+

+
+    data = open(RAW, "rb").read()

+    step = 4000

+            t = json.loads(r.Result()).get("text", "")
+            if t:
+                finals.append(t)
+        else:
+            p = json.loads(r.PartialResult()).get("partial", "")
+            if p and (not partials or partials[-1] != p):
+                partials.append(p)
+    t = json.loads(r.FinalResult()).get("text", "")
+    if t:
+        finals.append(t)
+
+    joined = ((" ".join(finals)) + " " + (" ".join(partials))).replace(" ", "")
+    hits = joined.count("小陈")
+    print()

+    print("识别片段：")
+    for x in finals:

+    print("出现「小陈」次数：%d / %d" % (hits, n))

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""wakeword.py — 离线语音唤醒：听到唤醒词自动触发语音助手。
+
+为什么用本地模型而不是云端：
+  唤醒要一直听，云端 ASR 一次要 1~2 秒还要走网络；本地小模型几十~几百毫秒
+  就出结果，而且待机时完全不消耗云端额度、不依赖网络。
+
+麦克风独占问题（关键）：
+  ALSA 的采集设备是独占的 —— 唤醒引擎拿着麦克风，语音助手就录不了音。
+  所以检测到唤醒词后，本程序**先关掉麦克风**，再触发助手，然后等助手
+  录完（靠监视 arecord 进程）才重新接管麦克风。
+
+  ★ 2026-09-17 修：arecord 对 SIGTERM 是"优雅退出"，如果它的 stdout 管道
+    已经写满而我们不再读，它会永远卡在 write() 上，SIGTERM 也杀不掉 ——
+    于是麦克风被这个残留进程独占，之后谁录音都报
+    "Device or resource busy"，唤醒引擎再也听不到东西（实测确认）。
+    现在关采集一律走 stop_recorder()：先关读端、再 SIGTERM、最后 SIGKILL 兜底。
+
+用法：
+    python3 wakeword.py                        # 默认唤醒词
+    python3 wakeword.py --keywords 你好小车,小车小车
+    python3 wakeword.py --fifo /tmp/voice_trigger
+
+配套：语音助手要用 FIFO 触发启动
+    bash 语音助手.sh   # 脚本里已是 --trigger fifo
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+MIC_DEFAULT = "plughw:CARD=hobotsnd5,DEV=0"
+RATE = 16000
+CHUNK = 4000          # 0.125 秒 @16k/16bit
+
+
+def log(msg):

+        out = subprocess.run(["ps", "-eo", "pid,ppid,comm"],
+                             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5).stdout
+    except Exception:
+        return pids
+    for line in out.splitlines()[1:]:
+        f = line.split()
+        if len(f) >= 3 and f[2] == "arecord" and f[1] == str(me):
+            try:
+                pids.append(int(f[0]))
+            except ValueError:
+                pass
+    return pids
+
+
+def stop_recorder(proc):
+    """安全关掉采集进程，确保它不会占着麦克风不走。
+
+    顺序很讲究：先关读端（让 arecord 的 write 立刻失败）-> SIGTERM ->
+    SIGKILL 兜底 -> 最后扫一遍自己的残留子进程强杀。
+    """
+    try:
+        if proc.stdout:
+            proc.stdout.close()
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    try:
+        proc.terminate()
+        proc.wait(timeout=2)
+    except Exception:
+        try:
+            proc.kill()
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        try:
+            proc.wait(timeout=2)
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+    for pid in own_arecords():
+        try:
+            os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+
+
+def assistant_busy() -> bool:
+    """助手是否正在录音（它用 arecord 采集）。
+
+    注意：不能把自己启动的 arecord 也算进去，否则一旦有残留，就会永远
+    认为"助手在忙"，再也不去听唤醒词。
+    """
+    mine = set(own_arecords())

+        r = subprocess.run(["pgrep", "-f", "arecord"],
+                           capture_output=True, text=True)
+    except Exception:

+        except ValueError:

+def trigger(fifo: str) -> bool:

+        try:

+        finally:

+        return True
+    except OSError as exc:

+        return False
+

+    """打开麦克风；打不开就返回 None（调用方等一会儿重试）。"""

+            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, bufsize=0)

+    time.sleep(0.3)

+        return None
+    return proc
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="离线唤醒词")
+    ap.add_argument("--model", default=os.path.expanduser(
+        "~/vosk-model-small-cn-0.22"))
+    ap.add_argument("--mic", default=MIC_DEFAULT)
+    ap.add_argument("--fifo", default="/tmp/voice_trigger")
+    # 唤醒词。人名类唤醒词小模型容易听错（"小陈同志"可能被识别成
+    # "小陈通知/小陈统计"），所以除了原词还带上特征词"小陈"做容错 ——
+    # 只要听出"小陈"就唤醒，漏唤醒少很多，也不会被普通聊天误触发。
+    ap.add_argument("--keywords", default="小陈同志,小陈")
+    ap.add_argument("--cooldown", type=float, default=2.0,
+                    help="触发后的冷却秒数，防止连触发")

+                    help="触发后最多等助手多少秒")

+    keys = [k.strip() for k in args.keywords.replace("，", ",").split(",") if k.strip()]

+    try:
+        from vosk import Model, KaldiRecognizer, SetLogLevel
+    except ImportError:
+        log("没有 vosk：先 python3 -m pip install --user vosk")

+    SetLogLevel(-1)
+
+    if not os.path.isdir(args.model):
+        log("找不到模型目录：%s" % args.model)

+    log("加载模型 %s …" % os.path.basename(args.model))
+    model = Model(args.model)
+    log("模型就绪。唤醒词：%s" % " / ".join(keys))
+    log("（对着板子说唤醒词即可，无需按键）")

+    last_fire = 0.0
+    while True:
+        # 助手在用麦克风时等着，别去抢
+        if assistant_busy():

+            continue

+            continue

+        rec = KaldiRecognizer(model, RATE)
+        log("开始监听…")
+        hit = None
+        try:
+            while True:
+                data = proc.stdout.read(CHUNK)
+                if not data:
+                    break
+                if rec.AcceptWaveform(data):
+                    text = _json_text(rec.Result(), "text")
+                else:
+                    text = _json_text(rec.PartialResult(), "partial")
+                if not text:

+                if hit and time.time() - last_fire > args.cooldown:
+                    last_fire = time.time()
+                    log("🎤 听到唤醒词「%s」（识别到：%s）" % (hit, text))
+                    break
+        except KeyboardInterrupt:
+            stop_recorder(proc)
+            raise
+        finally:
+            # 先放开麦克风，再触发助手
+            stop_recorder(proc)

+            log("采集流中断（麦克风被占？），重新打开")
+            time.sleep(1.0)
+            continue

+    ("字级：小 陈", '["小 陈", "[unk]"]'),
+    ("短语表", '["小陈同志", "小陈", "小 陈 同 志", "[unk]"]'),

+    try:
+        r = KaldiRecognizer(model, RATE, grammar) if grammar else KaldiRecognizer(model, RATE)
+    except Exception as exc:

+    if t:

```python
def build_grammar(keys):
    """把唤醒词转成 Vosk 的约束语法。

    中文模型是字级词表，所以要把「小陈同志」写成「小 陈 同 志」。
    加 [unk] 让模型对无关语音有出口，否则任何声音都会被硬塞成唤醒词。
    """
    words = []
    for k in keys:
        if " " in k:
            words.append(k)
        words.append(" ".join(k))
    words.append("[unk]")
    return json.dumps(words, ensure_ascii=False)
```

+# 语音唤醒（唤醒词：小陈同志）
+
+## 怎么用
+
+在板子终端里执行：
+
+```bash
+bash ~/voice_pipeline/重启语音.sh     # 后台跑，日志在 /tmp/voice_wake.log
+bash ~/voice_pipeline/唤醒.sh         # 前台跑，日志直接打在屏幕上
+```
+
+然后对着板子说 **「小陈同志」** → 它会说「请讲」→ 再说指令（例如
+「小车一前进三十厘米」）→ 它识别、下发给小车、并用语音回报结果。
+
+不想用唤醒词时也可以手动触发：
+
+```bash
+echo x > /tmp/voice_trigger
+```
+
+## 容错唤醒词
+
+离线小模型（Vosk `vosk-model-small-cn-0.22`）对「小陈」这种不常见词容易
+听错，所以实际接受三个词：**小陈同志 / 小陈 / 陈同志**。
+
+## 为什么要做「关键词约束解码」
+
+同一段「小陈同志」音频，4 次播放的实测对比：
+
+| 解码方式 | 认出「小陈」的次数 |
+|---|---|
+| 普通解码 | 2 / 4（常常听成「小川同志」「小传统」） |
+| 字级约束解码（现在用的） | 8 / 8（每次播放都命中） |
+
+用法上就是给 Vosk 传一个候选词表：中文模型是**字级**词表，所以要写成
+`["小 陈 同 志", "小 陈", "陈 同 志", "[unk]"]`。最后的 `[unk]` 不能省，
+否则模型会被迫把任何声音都硬塞成唤醒词。
+
+## 踩过的两个坑（都已修）
+
+1. **残留的 `arecord` 会永久占住麦克风。**
+   `arecord` 收到 SIGTERM 属于「优雅退出」，如果它的 stdout 管道已经写满
+   而没人再读，它会永远卡在 `write()` 上 —— 进程杀不掉，麦克风被独占，
+   之后谁录音都报 `Device or resource busy`，唤醒引擎彻底变聋。
+   现在关采集一律走 `stop_recorder()`：先关读端 → SIGTERM → SIGKILL 兜底。
+
+2. **助手处理一轮时，写 FIFO 会失败。**
+   助手只在「等触发」时才开着 FIFO 的读端，录音/识别/下发/播报期间读端
+   是关的，这时写会得到 `No such device or address`，表现为「明明听见了
+   唤醒词却没反应」。现在改成「挂单」：先非阻塞直写，写不进就派一个后台
+   进程用阻塞式 open 把这一字节挂上，助手回到等触发状态时自动送达。
+
+## 自检工具
+
+```bash
+python3 ~/voice_pipeline/唤醒自检.py        # 不用人说话：合成唤醒词→扬声器播→麦克风录→识别
+bash    ~/voice_pipeline/唤醒命中率.sh 8    # 连播 8 次唤醒词，统计命中率（实测 8/8）
+python3 ~/voice_pipeline/唤醒音频解码.py /tmp/wwdump2.raw   # 复解码录音，看当时到底听到了什么
+```
+
+`wakeword.py` 自带两个排查开关：`--level`（每 2 秒打印麦克风电平峰值）
+和 `--dump FILE`（把采集到的原始音频存一份）。
*** End Patch

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""探测 qwen-tts 支持哪些音色：逐个试，把成功/报错原样打出来。"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+
+API_URL = ("https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/api/v1/services/aigc/"
+           "multimodal-generation/generation")
+
+
+def api_key() -> str:
+    for name in ("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY", "QWEN_TTS_API_KEY"):
+        v = (os.environ.get(name) or "").strip()
+        if v:
+            return v
+    cfg = os.path.expanduser("~/.codex/qwen-asr.json")
+    return str(json.loads(open(cfg, encoding="utf-8").read()).get("api_key", ""))
+
+
+def try_voice(model: str, voice: str) -> str:
+    body = json.dumps({"model": model,
+                       "input": {"text": "测试", "voice": voice}},
+                      ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
+    req = urllib.request.Request(
+        API_URL, data=body,
+        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + api_key(),
+                 "Content-Type": "application/json"})
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as r:
+            data = json.load(r)
+        out = data.get("output") or {}
+        url = ((out.get("audio") or {}).get("url")) or out.get("audio_url")
+        return "OK" + ("（有音频）" if url else "（无音频）")
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
+        raw = exc.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
+        try:
+            j = json.loads(raw)
+            msg = j.get("message") or raw
+            code = j.get("code", "")
+            return "FAIL %s %s" % (code, msg)
+        except Exception:
+            return "FAIL HTTP %s %s" % (exc.code, raw[:400])
+    except Exception as exc:

def synth_parts(parts, voice: str = DEFAULT_VOICE) -> pathlib.Path:
    """把多段短语音拼成一个 wav。

    为什么要拼：多步任务要播"第一步，前进"这类话，如果每句都整句合成，
    组合数是 步数×动作数（几十条），预合成要多花几十次请求还容易触发限流。
    拆成"序数词"+"动作名"两类短片段（各 6~8 条），任意组合都能拼出来，
    而且片段命中缓存时拼接本身是纯本地操作，零延迟。
    """
    parts = [p for p in parts if p]
    if not parts:
        raise ValueError("没有可播报的片段")
    if len(parts) == 1:
        return synth(parts[0], voice)

    CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dst = cache_path("\x01".join(parts), voice)
    if dst.is_file() and dst.stat().st_size > 1000:
        return dst

    files = [synth(p, voice) for p in parts]
    frames = []
    fmt = None
    for f in files:
        with wave.open(str(f)) as w:
            cur = (w.getnchannels(), w.getsampwidth(), w.getframerate())
            if fmt is None:
                fmt = cur
            elif cur != fmt:
                raise RuntimeError("片段音频格式不一致，无法拼接：%s vs %s" % (fmt, cur))
            frames.append(w.readframes(w.getnframes()))

    tmp = dst.with_suffix(".part")
    with wave.open(str(tmp), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(fmt[0])
        w.setsampwidth(fmt[1])
        w.setframerate(fmt[2])
        w.writeframes(b"".join(frames))
    tmp.replace(dst)
    return dst


def say_parts(parts, voice: str = DEFAULT_VOICE, block: bool = True,
              verbose: bool = False) -> bool:
    """拼接播放多个片段（任一段失败就整体放弃，不抛异常）。"""
    try:
        t0 = time.time()
        path = synth_parts(parts, voice)
        if verbose:
            print("  [tts] 拼接 %s（%.2fs）-> %s"
                  % ("+".join(parts), time.time() - t0, path.name))
        return play(path, block=block)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        print("  [tts] 失败（不影响主流程）：%s" % exc, file=sys.stderr)
        return False


def say(text: str, voice: str = DEFAULT_VOICE, block: bool = True,
        verbose: bool = False) -> bool:
    """合成并播放。任何失败都返回 False，不抛异常。"""
    text = (text or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return False
    try:
        t0 = time.time()
        path = synth(text, voice)
        cached = time.time() - t0 < 0.2
        if verbose:
            print("  [tts] %s%s -> %s"
                  % ("缓存命中 " if cached else "已合成 ", round(time.time() - t0, 2),
                     path.name))
        return play(path, block=block)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        print("  [tts] 失败（不影响主流程）：%s" % exc, file=sys.stderr)
        return False

| 目标车 | 播报 |
|---|---|
| 1 辆 | 2号车， |

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""地图去噪：把"孤立占据点"改回未知。

SLAM 出来的栅格里常有一些稀稀拉拉的孤立黑点（雷达噪声、远处穿透门的回波）。
判据：一个占据格如果 8 邻域里的占据格少于 2 个，就认为它不是真实结构。
墙是连续的粗线，邻域里必有多个占据格，不会被误删。
"""
import sys

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
im = np.array(Image.open(src).convert("L"))
occ = im < 100

neigh = np.zeros_like(occ, dtype=np.int16)
for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
        if dx == 0 and dy == 0:
            continue
        neigh += np.roll(np.roll(occ, dy, axis=0), dx, axis=1).astype(np.int16)

drop = occ & (neigh < 2)
out = im.copy()
out[drop] = 205          # 改回"未知"

print("占据格 %d -> %d（去掉孤立点 %d 个，%.1f%%）"
      % (occ.sum(), (out < 100).sum(), drop.sum(),
         100.0 * drop.sum() / max(occ.sum(), 1)))
Image.fromarray(out).save(dst)

import os
from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory

from launch_ros.actions import PushRosNamespace
from launch import LaunchDescription, LaunchService
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch.launch_description_sources import PythonLaunchDescriptionSource
from launch.actions import DeclareLaunchArgument, IncludeLaunchDescription, GroupAction, OpaqueFunction, TimerAction

def launch_setup(context):
    compiled = os.environ.get('need_compile', 'False')
    enable_save = LaunchConfiguration('enable_save', default='true').perform(context)
    slam_method = LaunchConfiguration('slam_method', default='slam_toolbox').perform(context)
    sim = LaunchConfiguration('sim', default='false').perform(context)
    master_name = LaunchConfiguration('master_name', default=os.environ.get('MASTER', '/')).perform(context)
    robot_name = LaunchConfiguration('robot_name', default=os.environ.get('HOST', '/')).perform(context)

    enable_save_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('enable_save', default_value=enable_save)
    slam_method_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('slam_method', default_value=slam_method)
    sim_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('sim', default_value=sim)
    master_name_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('master_name', default_value=master_name)
    robot_name_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('robot_name', default_value=robot_name)

    frame_prefix = '' if robot_name == '/' else f'{robot_name}/'
    use_sim_time = 'true' if sim == 'true' else 'false'
    map_frame = f'{frame_prefix}map'
    odom_frame = f'{frame_prefix}odom'
    base_frame = f'{frame_prefix}base_footprint'

    if compiled == 'True':
        slam_package_path = get_package_share_directory('slam')
    else:
        slam_package_path = '/home/ubuntu/ros2_ws/src/slam'

    base_launch = IncludeLaunchDescription(
        PythonLaunchDescriptionSource(
            os.path.join(slam_package_path, 'launch/include/robot.launch.py')),
        launch_arguments={
            'sim': sim,
            'master_name': master_name,
            'robot_name': robot_name
        }.items(),
    )

    slam_launch = IncludeLaunchDescription(
        PythonLaunchDescriptionSource(
            os.path.join(slam_package_path, 'launch/include/slam_base.launch.py')),
        launch_arguments={
            'use_sim_time': use_sim_time,
            'map_frame': map_frame,
            'odom_frame': odom_frame,
            'base_frame': base_frame,
            'scan_topic': f'{frame_prefix}scan_raw',  # Using scan_raw topic
            'enable_save': enable_save
        }.items(),
    )

    if slam_method == 'slam_toolbox':
        bringup_launch = GroupAction(
            actions=[
                PushRosNamespace(robot_name),
                base_launch,
                TimerAction(
                    period=10.0,
                    actions=[slam_launch],
                ),
            ]
        )

    return [sim_arg, master_name_arg, robot_name_arg, slam_method_arg, bringup_launch]

def generate_launch_description():
    return LaunchDescription([
        OpaqueFunction(function=launch_setup)
    ])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    ld = generate_launch_description()

    ls = LaunchService()
    ls.include_launch_description(ld)
    ls.run()

import os
from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory

from launch_ros.actions import Node
from nav2_common.launch import RewrittenYaml
from launch.actions import DeclareLaunchArgument, OpaqueFunction
from launch import LaunchDescription, LaunchService
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration

def launch_setup(context):
    compiled = os.environ['need_compile']
    enable_save = LaunchConfiguration('enable_save', default='true').perform(context)
    use_sim_time = LaunchConfiguration('use_sim_time', default='false')
    map_frame = LaunchConfiguration('map_frame', default='map')
    odom_frame = LaunchConfiguration('odom_frame', default='odom')
    base_frame = LaunchConfiguration('base_frame', default='base_footprint')
    scan_topic = LaunchConfiguration('scan_topic', default='scan_raw')

    enable_save_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('enable_save', default_value=enable_save)
    use_sim_time_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('use_sim_time', default_value=use_sim_time)
    map_frame_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('map_frame', default_value=map_frame)
    odom_frame_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('odom_frame', default_value=odom_frame)
    base_frame_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('base_frame', default_value=base_frame)
    scan_topic_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('scan_topic', default_value=scan_topic)

    if compiled == 'True':
        slam_package_path = get_package_share_directory('slam')
    else:
        slam_package_path = '/home/ubuntu/ros2_ws/src/slam'

    slam_params = RewrittenYaml(
        source_file=os.path.join(slam_package_path, 'config/slam.yaml'),
        param_rewrites={
            'use_sim_time': use_sim_time,
            'map_frame': map_frame,
            'odom_frame': odom_frame,
            'base_frame': base_frame,
            },
        convert_types=True
    )

    remappings=[
        ('/tf', 'tf'),
        ('/tf_static', 'tf_static'),
        ('/map', 'map'),
        ('/map_metadata', 'map_metadata'),
    ]
    if enable_save == 'false':
        remappings.append(('/slam_toolbox/save_map', '/save_map'))

    sync_node = Node(package='slam_toolbox',
         executable='sync_slam_toolbox_node',
         name='slam_toolbox',
         output='screen',
         parameters=[
           slam_params,
         ],
         remappings=remappings
    )

    return [
        enable_save_arg,
        use_sim_time_arg,
        map_frame_arg,
        odom_frame_arg,
        base_frame_arg,
        scan_topic_arg,
        sync_node
    ]

def generate_launch_description():
    return LaunchDescription([
        OpaqueFunction(function = launch_setup)
    ])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    ld = generate_launch_description()

    ls = LaunchService()
    ls.include_launch_description(ld)

# MentorPi SLAM / localization / multi-robot bringup

This package is the hardware-side bridge for product CZ225: the Hiwonder
Raspberry Pi 5 MentorPi M1 mecanum chassis. It assumes the vendor drivers
publish standard ROS 2 interfaces, but it does not guess their final topic or
frame names. Verify them on the first car before enabling motion.

## 0. Network and driver contract

On every car and the operator laptop, source `scripts/set_multi_robot_env.sh`
with the same `ROS_DOMAIN_ID` (the template defaults to 42). Keep
`ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=0`. Start the MentorPi base/chassis driver, wheel-encoder
odometry and the 2D lidar driver first. The contract needed by this package is:

| Interface | Type | Required frame/topic |
| --- | --- | --- |
| velocity command | `geometry_msgs/Twist` | `<robot>/controller/cmd_vel` |
| wheel/IMU odometry | `nav_msgs/Odometry` | `<robot>/odom`, child `<robot>/base_link` |
| planar laser | `sensor_msgs/LaserScan` | `<robot>/scan_raw`, frame `<robot>/laser` |
| global pose | `geometry_msgs/PoseWithCovarianceStamped` | `<robot>/amcl_pose`, frame `map` |

The exact vendor topics may differ. Use `ros2 topic list`,
`ros2 topic type`, `ros2 topic echo`, and `ros2 run tf2_tools view_frames` to
fill the mapping before touching the formation node.

## 1. One-car classroom mapping (teleoperation)

Install this package in the car's `ros2_ws`, then run the vendor base and lidar
launch files. Verify the laser in RViz2 before mapping:

```bash
ros2 topic hz /robot01/scan_raw
ros2 topic echo /robot01/scan_raw --once
ros2 run tf2_ros tf2_echo robot01/base_link robot01/laser
```

The lidar transform must be measured, not copied from this template. If the
vendor URDF does not provide it, launch the fallback after replacing `z` and
`yaw` with measured values:


2D SLAM package and provides loop closure and a serialized pose graph. This is
preferable to writing a new lidar SLAM algorithm for this classroom-scale map.

## 2. Single-car map localization

After the map is saved, stop mapping and start AMCL with the same calibrated
TF and odometry frames:

```bash
ros2 launch mentorpi_formation_bringup localization.launch.py \
  namespace:=robot01 map:=~/maps/classroom.yaml \
  odom_frame:=robot01/odom base_frame:=robot01/base_link
ros2 topic pub --once /robot01/initialpose \
  geometry_msgs/PoseWithCovarianceStamped "..."
```

Use RViz2 `2D Pose Estimate` to initialize, then verify `map -> robot01/odom`
and `robot01/odom -> robot01/base_link`. AMCL is the default static-map
localizer here because it is robust to kidnapped-robot recovery and does not
continue changing the classroom map. If continuous pose-graph localization is
desired, use slam_toolbox localization mode with the serialized pose graph
instead; do not run AMCL and slam_toolbox localization simultaneously.

The AMCL configuration uses `nav2_amcl::OmniMotionModel`, not the differential
model, because the M1 mecanum chassis has real lateral velocity. The formation
agent consumes `/robotXX/amcl_pose` for global `map` position and covariance;
`/robotXX/odom` supplies body-frame velocity only. It rejects stale poses,
wrong frame IDs and excessive x/y/yaw covariance before publishing motion.
For a measured initial pose, the bundled publisher waits for the correct AMCL
subscriber before sending it:

```bash
ros2 run mentorpi_formation_bringup set_initial_pose \
  --namespace robot01 --x 1.20 --y -0.75 --yaw 1.5708
```

For better odometry, the optional `config/ekf_odom_imu.yaml` documents a
two-dimensional `robot_localization` EKF. Enable it only after replacing its
placeholder `/odom/raw` and `/imu/data` topics and deciding which node owns
the `odom -> base_link` transform. There must be exactly one TF publisher for
that edge.

## 3. Four cars on one map

Copy the same map YAML/PGM to the operator host or a map-server car. Start:

```bash
ros2 launch mentorpi_formation_bringup multi_robot_localization.launch.py \
  map:=/home/vela/maps/classroom.yaml
ros2 run mentorpi_formation_bringup tf_audit
```

The launch creates one global `map` and four isolated AMCL nodes. The required
tree is:

```text
map
├── robot01/odom ── robot01/base_link ── robot01/laser
├── robot02/odom ── robot02/base_link ── robot02/laser
├── robot03/odom ── robot03/base_link ── robot03/laser
└── robot04/odom ── robot04/base_link ── robot04/laser
```

Only `map` is shared. Every odom, base, laser, cmd_vel, scan and status topic
must be namespaced. Initialize each car separately in RViz2 and run
`tf_audit` until all four `map -> odom -> base_link` chains are present,
finite, and distinct. If two cars start at the same physical location, use
AprilTag/known landmarks or a measured tape/grid to disambiguate their initial
poses; simply copying one initial pose to all four is not accurate localization.

When the graph is stable, launch one `mentorpi_agent.py` per car with its
matching namespace and the shared-map odometry. Only then enable the existing
formation mission gateway and choose `anchored`, `laplacian`, or `second_order`.

## 4. QEMU virtual hardware acceptance

The package includes a deterministic four-car stand-in that publishes the same
topic and TF contract and integrates each car's own holonomic command:

```bash
ros2 run mentorpi_formation_bringup virtual_fleet
ros2 run mentorpi_formation_bringup hardware_probe \
  --namespace robot01 --require-localization
ros2 run mentorpi_formation_bringup tf_audit
ros2 run mentorpi_formation_bringup virtual_acceptance \
  --control-mode laplacian
```

This proves ROS discovery, topic types, namespace isolation, TF composition,
AMCL-pose consumption and distributed command flow. Synthetic poses/scans do
not prove physical lidar accuracy or produce a real classroom map.

## 5. Acceptance gates before formation

1. One car: scan rate stable, laser TF measured, mapping closes its loop, and
   saved map is readable.
2. One car: AMCL covariance settles while driving a rectangle; no TF jumps or
   duplicate publishers.
3. Four cars: same `ROS_DOMAIN_ID`, all topics discoverable, four unique TF
   chains, each robot's covariance and map pose logged.
4. Wheels raised: verify `cmd_vel` x/y signs and mecanum lateral motion.
5. Floor test: low speed, large separation, hardware output enabled only after
   the preceding gates pass.

The QEMU formation lab can validate graph/controller mathematics now, but it
cannot produce a classroom map or certify real lidar/odometry accuracy.

For a four-car installable handoff, use `deploy/install_on_robot.sh` from the
bundle root. It installs disabled-by-default systemd services and runs a
hardware/TF preflight before allowing formation output.

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections.abc import Sequence


def normalize_angle(angle: float) -> float:
    return math.atan2(math.sin(angle), math.cos(angle))


def directional_clearance(
    ranges: Sequence[float],
    angle_min: float,
    angle_increment: float,
    range_min: float,
    range_max: float,
    direction_rad: float,
    half_angle_rad: float,
) -> float | None:
    """Return the nearest valid lidar range in a body-relative sector."""
    nearest: float | None = None
    for index, raw_range in enumerate(ranges):
        distance = float(raw_range)
        if not math.isfinite(distance) or distance < range_min or distance > range_max:
            continue
        ray_angle = angle_min + index * angle_increment
        if abs(normalize_angle(ray_angle - direction_rad)) > half_angle_rad:
            continue
        nearest = distance if nearest is None else min(nearest, distance)
    return nearest


def clearance_speed_scale(clearance_m: float, stop_m: float, slow_m: float) -> float:
    if stop_m <= 0.0 or slow_m <= stop_m:
        raise ValueError("require 0 < stop_m < slow_m")
    if clearance_m <= stop_m:
        return 0.0
    if clearance_m >= slow_m:
        return 1.0
    return (clearance_m - stop_m) / (slow_m - stop_m)

```python
async def main():
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reliably seed one namespaced AMCL instance in the shared map frame."""

import argparse
import json
import math
import sys
import time

import rclpy
from geometry_msgs.msg import PoseWithCovarianceStamped


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--namespace", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--x", type=float, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--y", type=float, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--yaw", type=float, required=True, help="radians, counter-clockwise")
    parser.add_argument("--xy-variance", type=float, default=0.04)
    parser.add_argument("--yaw-variance", type=float, default=0.0685)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=5.0)
    args, ros_args = parser.parse_known_args(argv)
    if args.xy_variance <= 0.0 or args.yaw_variance <= 0.0:
        parser.error("variances must be positive")

    rclpy.init(args=ros_args)
    node = rclpy.create_node("mentorpi_set_initial_pose")
    topic = f"/{args.namespace.strip('/')}/initialpose"
    publisher = node.create_publisher(PoseWithCovarianceStamped, topic, 10)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + args.timeout
    while rclpy.ok() and publisher.get_subscription_count() == 0 and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        rclpy.spin_once(node, timeout_sec=0.1)
    if publisher.get_subscription_count() == 0:
        print(json.dumps({"ok": False, "topic": topic, "error": "no AMCL subscriber"}, ensure_ascii=False))
        node.destroy_node()
        rclpy.shutdown()
        return 2

    message = PoseWithCovarianceStamped()
    message.header.frame_id = "map"
    message.pose.pose.position.x = args.x
    message.pose.pose.position.y = args.y
    message.pose.pose.orientation.z = math.sin(args.yaw * 0.5)
    message.pose.pose.orientation.w = math.cos(args.yaw * 0.5)
    message.pose.covariance[0] = args.xy_variance
    message.pose.covariance[7] = args.xy_variance
    message.pose.covariance[35] = args.yaw_variance
    for _ in range(3):
        message.header.stamp = node.get_clock().now().to_msg()
        publisher.publish(message)
        rclpy.spin_once(node, timeout_sec=0.1)
    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "topic": topic, "x": args.x, "y": args.y, "yaw": args.yaw}, ensure_ascii=False))
    node.destroy_node()
    rclpy.shutdown()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""把四台车在共享地图里的 AMCL 位姿画出来，核对是否落在房间里。
+
+    python3 plot_poses.py <map.pgm> <out.png> x1 y1 yaw1 x2 y2 yaw2 ...
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+
+ORIGIN = (-5.73, -7.44)
+RES = 0.05
+
+
+def main():
+    src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    nums = [float(v) for v in sys.argv[3:]]
+    poses = [(nums[i], nums[i + 1], nums[i + 2]) for i in range(0, len(nums), 3)]
+
+    im = Image.open(src).convert("RGB")
+    w, h = im.size
+    arr = np.array(im.convert("L"))
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
+
+    for idx, (x, y, yaw) in enumerate(poses, 1):
+        px = (x - ORIGIN[0]) / RES
+        py = (h - 1) - (y - ORIGIN[1]) / RES
+        inside = 0 <= px < w and 0 <= py < h
+        cell = arr[int(py), int(px)] if inside else None
+        kind = {None: "越界", 205: "未知", 254: "空闲", 0: "障碍"}.get(
+            cell, "灰%s" % cell)
+        print("车 %d: 地图坐标 (%.2f, %.2f) yaw=%.0f° -> 像素 (%d, %d) 落在%s"
+              % (idx, x, y, math.degrees(yaw), px, py, kind))
+        r = 7
+        d.ellipse([px - r, py - r, px + r, py + r], fill=(220, 30, 30),
+                  outline=(0, 0, 0))
+        # 朝向短线
+        ex, ey = px + 26 * math.cos(yaw), py - 26 * math.sin(yaw)
+        d.line([px, py, ex, ey], fill=(20, 90, 220), width=3)
+        d.text((px + 9, py - 18), "car%d" % idx, fill=(0, 0, 0))
+
+    im.save(dst)
+    print("已保存", dst)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

**新起的节点收不到数据。** 容器 `/dev/shm` 攒到 200 多个 `fastrtps_*` 段后，FastDDS 共享内存传输会静默失效：`ros2 topic echo` 卡死、slam_toolbox 一直不建图。加一个 UDP-only 的 profile 就恢复，定位服务也一并加上了（原脚本备份为 `run_localization.sh.bak-20260917`）。

**重复的定位实例。** 反复重启会在容器里堆出好几组同名 `map_server`/`amcl`，lifecycle 的服务调用打到「错的那份」上，报 `Failed to change state for node: map_server`——地图明明加载成功却激活不了。车 1 上实测堆了 4 组，清理脚本是 `cleanup_localization.sh`。

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""用一帧真实雷达扫描给候选位姿打分：扫描端点落在墙体上的比例越高越可信。
+
+    python3 score_pose.py <map.pgm> <car_ip> x1 y1 yaw1 [x2 y2 yaw2 ...]
+
+做法：把扫描点从车体系投到地图系，看每个端点是否落在地图的"占据格"或
+它周围 2 格内；得分 = 命中比例。位姿错了，扫描线就会穿墙，得分明显下降。
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import json
+import math
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+import websockets
+from PIL import Image
+
+ORIGIN = (-5.73, -7.44)
+RES = 0.05
+# 雷达相对车体的小偏移（与建图脚本一致；量级 1 cm，对打分无影响）
+DX, DY = -0.0122, -0.0001
+
+
+async def grab_scan(ip):
+    url = "ws://%s:9090" % ip
+    async with websockets.connect(url, open_timeout=8, max_size=2 ** 23) as ws:
+        await ws.send(json.dumps({"op": "subscribe", "topic": "/scan_raw",
+                                  "type": "sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan"}))
+        while True:
+            d = json.loads(await asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(), timeout=10))
+            if d.get("op") == "publish" and d.get("topic") == "/scan_raw":
+                m = d["msg"]
+                r = np.array([float(v) if isinstance(v, (int, float)) else np.nan
+                              for v in m["ranges"]])
+                ang = m["angle_min"] + np.arange(len(r)) * m["angle_increment"]
+                rmax = float(m.get("range_max") or 10.0) * 0.95
+                ok = np.isfinite(r) & (r > 0.15) & (r < rmax)
+                return r[ok], ang[ok], rmax
+
+
+def occupancy_mask(pgm):
+    im = Image.open(pgm).convert("L")
+    arr = np.array(im)
+    occ = arr < 100
+    # 膨胀 2 格（10 cm）：扫描点不会精确落在格子上
+    dil = occ.copy()
+    for _ in range(2):
+        d = dil.copy()
+        d[1:, :] |= dil[:-1, :]
+        d[:-1, :] |= dil[1:, :]
+        d[:, 1:] |= dil[:, :-1]
+        d[:, :-1] |= dil[:, 1:]
+        dil = d
+    return arr, dil
+
+
+def score(occ_dil, arr, ranges, angs, x, y, yaw):
+    # 车体系点
+    px = DX + ranges * np.cos(angs)
+    py = DY + ranges * np.sin(angs)
+    c, s = math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw)
+    wx = x + c * px - s * py
+    wy = y + s * px + c * py
+    cols = ((wx - ORIGIN[0]) / RES).astype(int)
+    rows = (occ_dil.shape[0] - 1 - ((wy - ORIGIN[1]) / RES)).astype(int)
+    ok = (cols >= 0) & (cols < occ_dil.shape[1]) & (rows >= 0) & (rows < occ_dil.shape[0])
+    if ok.sum() == 0:
+        return 0.0, 0, 0
+    hit = occ_dil[rows[ok], cols[ok]]
+    on_wall = arr[rows[ok], cols[ok]] < 100
+    return hit.mean(), int(hit.sum()), int(on_wall.sum())
+
+
+def main():
+    pgm, ip = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    nums = [float(v) for v in sys.argv[3:]]
+    cands = [(nums[i], nums[i + 1], nums[i + 2]) for i in range(0, len(nums), 3)]
+    arr, dil = occupancy_mask(pgm)
+    ranges, angs, rmax = asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(grab_scan(ip))
+    print("扫描：%d 个有效点，量程 %.1f m，地图 %s" % (len(ranges), rmax, pgm))
+    results = []
+    for x, y, yaw in cands:
+        sc, near, on = score(dil, arr, ranges, angs, x, y, yaw)
+        results.append((sc, x, y, yaw))
+        print("  (%6.3f, %6.3f, %6.1f°) -> 命中墙体 %.1f%%（贴合 %d 点，正中墙 %d 点）"
+              % (x, y, math.degrees(yaw), 100 * sc, near, on))
+    results.sort(reverse=True)
+    best = results[0]
+    print("最佳位姿：(%.3f, %.3f, %.1f°)，命中 %.1f%%"
+          % (best[1], best[2], math.degrees(best[3]), 100 * best[0]))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""从四台车的 rosbridge 各取一条当前 AMCL 位姿。
+
+    python3 fetch_poses.py            # 输出每台车的 x y yaw(rad) 及协方差
+
+只收带新时间戳、frame_id=map 的消息，避免拿到过期数据。
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import json
+import math
+import time
+
+import websockets
+
+CARS = [("car1", "192.168.1.201"), ("car2", "192.168.1.202"),
+        ("car3", "192.168.1.203"), ("car4", "192.168.1.204")]
+
+
+async def one(name, ip, timeout=12.0):
+    url = "ws://%s:9090" % ip
+    try:
+        async with websockets.connect(url, open_timeout=6, max_size=2 ** 22) as ws:
+            await ws.send(json.dumps({
+                "op": "subscribe", "topic": "/amcl_pose",
+                "type": "geometry_msgs/msg/PoseWithCovarianceStamped"}))
+            t0 = time.time()
+            while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
+                d = json.loads(await asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(), timeout=timeout))
+                if d.get("op") != "publish" or d.get("topic") != "/amcl_pose":
+                    continue
+                m = d["msg"]
+                p = m["pose"]["pose"]
+                q = p["orientation"]
+                yaw = math.atan2(2.0 * (q["w"] * q["z"] + q["x"] * q["y"]),
+                                 1.0 - 2.0 * (q["y"] ** 2 + q["z"] ** 2))
+                cov = m["pose"]["covariance"]
+                return (name, ip, p["position"]["x"], p["position"]["y"], yaw,
+                        cov[0], cov[7], cov[35])
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        print("%s 读取失败：%s" % (name, exc))
+    return None
+
+
+async def main():
+    res = await asyncio.gather(*[one(n, ip) for n, ip in CARS])
+    print("时间：%s" % time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
+    args = []
+    for r in res:
+        if not r:
+            continue
+        name, ip, x, y, yaw, cx, cy, cw = r
+        print("%s (%s)  x=%7.3f  y=%7.3f  yaw=%6.1f°  cov_xy=%.5f cov_yaw=%.5f"
+              % (name, ip, x, y, math.degrees(yaw), cx, cw))
+        args += ["%.4f" % x, "%.4f" % y, "%.4f" % yaw]
+    print("绘图参数：%s" % " ".join(args))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(main())

def circular_mean(values: list[float]) -> float:
    if not values:
        raise ValueError("no headings")
    return math.atan2(sum(math.sin(value) for value in values), sum(math.cos(value) for value in values))


def build_relative_mission(
    poses: dict[str, tuple[float, float, float]],
    distance_m: float,
    duration_s: float,
    formation: str,
    spacing_m: float,
    control_mode: str,
    experiment_id: str,
    now_unix_s: float,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if set(poses) != set(ROBOT_IDS):
        raise ValueError("all four poses are required")
    if not math.isfinite(distance_m) or abs(distance_m) > 0.5:
        raise ValueError("distance must be finite and no more than 0.5 m")
    if not math.isfinite(duration_s) or not 1.0 <= duration_s <= 20.0:
        raise ValueError("duration must be between 1 and 20 seconds")
    center_x = sum(pose[0] for pose in poses.values()) / len(ROBOT_IDS)
    center_y = sum(pose[1] for pose in poses.values()) / len(ROBOT_IDS)
    heading = circular_mean([pose[2] for pose in poses.values()])
    return {
        "enabled": True,
        "phase": "prepare",
        "experiment_id": experiment_id,
        "formation": formation,
        "spacing_m": spacing_m,
        "center_x": center_x + distance_m * math.cos(heading),
        "center_y": center_y + distance_m * math.sin(heading),
        "heading_rad": heading,
        "control_mode": control_mode,
        "deadline_unix_s": now_unix_s + duration_s,
    }


def validate_geometry(
    poses: dict[str, tuple[float, float, float]],
    mission: dict[str, Any],
    arena_half_extent_m: float,
    min_distance_m: float,
) -> None:
    for index, first in enumerate(ROBOT_IDS):
        for second in ROBOT_IDS[index + 1 :]:
            distance = math.hypot(poses[first][0] - poses[second][0], poses[first][1] - poses[second][1])
            if distance < min_distance_m:
                raise ValueError(f"{first}/{second} separation {distance:.3f} m is unsafe")
    offsets = formation_offsets(str(mission["formation"]), float(mission["spacing_m"]))
    cosine = math.cos(float(mission["heading_rad"]))
    sine = math.sin(float(mission["heading_rad"]))
    for robot_id, (offset_x, offset_y) in offsets.items():

        target_y = float(mission["center_y"]) + sine * offset_x + cosine * offset_y
        if abs(target_x) > arena_half_extent_m or abs(target_y) > arena_half_extent_m:

def arena_bounds_from_config(limits: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
    """Return configured map-frame bounds as (min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y)."""
    configured = limits.get("arena_bounds_m")
    if configured is None:
        half = float(limits.get("arena_half_extent_m", 3.0))
        bounds = (-half, half, -half, half)
    else:
        bounds = tuple(float(configured[key]) for key in ("min_x", "max_x", "min_y", "max_y"))
    if (
        len(bounds) != 4
        or not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in bounds)
        or bounds[0] >= bounds[1]
        or bounds[2] >= bounds[3]
    ):
        raise ValueError("invalid arena bounds")
    return bounds


def point_in_arena(x: float, y: float, bounds: tuple[float, float, float, float]) -> bool:
    return math.isfinite(x) and math.isfinite(y) and bounds[0] <= x <= bounds[1] and bounds[2] <= y <= bounds[3]

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""可见性矩阵：本机能收到多少个 robotN 的位姿/速度（域 42）。
+
+    python3 pose_visibility.py [秒数]
+
+在每台车上各跑一次，就能看出车队域的连通情况。
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+import time
+
+import rclpy
+from geometry_msgs.msg import PoseWithCovarianceStamped
+from nav_msgs.msg import Odometry
+
+SECS = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 20.0
+ROBOTS = ["robot1", "robot2", "robot3", "robot4"]
+
+rclpy.init()
+node = rclpy.create_node("codex_visibility")
+pose_count = {r: 0 for r in ROBOTS}
+odom_count = {r: 0 for r in ROBOTS}
+
+
+def mk_pose(rid):
+    def cb(_msg):
+        pose_count[rid] += 1
+    return cb
+
+
+def mk_odom(rid):
+    def cb(_msg):
+        odom_count[rid] += 1
+    return cb
+
+
+for r in ROBOTS:
+    node.create_subscription(PoseWithCovarianceStamped, "/%s/amcl_pose" % r, mk_pose(r), 10)
+    node.create_subscription(Odometry, "/%s/odom" % r, mk_odom(r), 10)
+
+t0 = time.time()
+while time.time() - t0 < SECS:
+    rclpy.spin_once(node, timeout_sec=0.2)
+
+print("本机(%s) %.0f 秒内收到的消息数：" % (node.get_namespace(), SECS))
+for r in ROBOTS:
+    print("   %s  位姿 %5d 条   速度 %5d 条" % (r, pose_count[r], odom_count[r]))
+node.destroy_node()
+rclpy.shutdown()
*** End Patch

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""给车队的 systemd 启动脚本加上统一的 DDS profile 环境变量。
+
+涉及 /opt/openvela-formation/scripts/ 下的：
+    run_fleet_bridge.sh      车队数据桥（读只读）
+    run_command_bridge.sh    指令桥（受 lease 管控）
+    run_formation_agent.sh   编队 agent
+
+做法：在 "docker exec" 之后插入 --env FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE=...，
+这样 profile 会传进容器（只设 systemd 的 Environment= 是传不进去的）。
+
+在车上用 sudo 跑：sudo python3 patch_fleet_scripts.py
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pathlib
+import shutil
+import sys
+
+SCRIPTS = pathlib.Path("/opt/openvela-formation/scripts")
+FILES = ["run_fleet_bridge.sh", "run_command_bridge.sh", "run_formation_agent.sh"]
+ENV = "--env FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE=/home/ubuntu/shared/fleet_udp_unicast.xml"
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    changed = 0
+    for name in FILES:
+        path = SCRIPTS / name
+        if not path.is_file():
+            print("找不到 %s，跳过" % path)
+            continue
+        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        if "FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE" in text:
+            print("跳过（已加过）：%s" % name)
+            continue
+        if "docker exec" not in text:
+            print("✗ %s 里没有 docker exec，跳过" % name)
+            continue
+        shutil.copy2(path, str(path) + ".bak-unicast")
+        path.write_text(text.replace("docker exec", "docker exec " + ENV, 1),
+                        encoding="utf-8")
+        print("已加：%s" % name)
+        changed += 1
+    print("共修改 %d 个脚本" % changed)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
*** End Patch

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""读四台车的电池电压/电量（板子经 rosbridge 读，走 TCP）。"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import json
+import time
+
+import websockets
+
+CARS = [("car1", "192.168.1.201"), ("car2", "192.168.1.202"),
+        ("car3", "192.168.1.203"), ("car4", "192.168.1.204")]
+
+
+async def one(name, ip):
+    url = "ws://%s:9090" % ip
+    try:
+        async with websockets.connect(url, open_timeout=6) as ws:
+            await ws.send(json.dumps({
+                "op": "subscribe", "topic": "/ros_robot_controller/battery",
+                "type": "sensor_msgs/msg/BatteryState"}))
+            t0 = time.time()
+            while time.time() - t0 < 10:
+                d = json.loads(await asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(), timeout=10))
+                if d.get("op") == "publish" and d.get("topic") == "/ros_robot_controller/battery":
+                    m = d["msg"]
+                    return (name, m.get("voltage"), m.get("percentage"),
+                            m.get("data") if isinstance(m.get("data"), (int, float)) else None)
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        return (name, None, None, str(exc)[:60])
+    return (name, None, None, "超时")
+
+
+async def main():
+    res = await asyncio.gather(*[one(n, ip) for n, ip in CARS])
+    for name, v, pct, extra in res:
+        if v is None and pct is None:
+            print("%s: 读不到（%s）" % (name, extra))
+        else:
+            pctv = "%.0f%%" % (pct * 100) if isinstance(pct, float) and pct <= 1.5 else str(pct)
+            print("%s: 电压 %s V，电量 %s" % (name, v, pctv))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(main())

四台车现在都停在安全状态，但**编队在当前网络下跑不起来**，我把原因和证据讲清楚。

## 现在的状态

四个编队 agent 已全部停止并禁用开机自启（不会再自己动），没有任何 mission、没有 arming lease。车 1 的厂商栈正常，但它的 amcl 现在激活失败（老毛病：DDS 生命周期切换）；车 1 在 **19:17 重启过一次**（负载 4.7），大概率是电量/供电问题——你之前也提到车 4 没电过。

## 我这轮修的两个真 bug（不修编队永远起不来）

`mentorpi_agent.py` 一启动就崩：位姿元组实际是 6 元 `(x, y, yaw, ok, 接收时刻, 消息时间戳)`，取值处只解包了 5 个 → `ValueError: too many values to unpack`。另外 agent 订阅 `/robotN/odom` 用的是 RELIABLE，而车队桥用 BEST_EFFORT 发布，日志一直刷「incompatible QoS」——**速度反馈根本收不到**，相对编队的误差项算不出来。两处都改好并推到了四台车（原文件有 `.bak-agentfix-*` 备份）。

## 真正的拦路虎：车与车之间的网络

编队要求每台车的 agent 都能看到另外三台的位置。实测：

| 测试 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 车 2 → 车 1 发 UDP 单播包 | **收不到**（超时） |
| 车 2 → 车 1 的 TCP 22 | 通 |
| 车 2 → 车 1 的 ping | 不通 |
| 跨车 DDS 可见性 | 忽多忽少（同一脚本一会儿看到 1 台，一会儿看到 3 台） |
| 板子到四台车的端口连通性 | 每测一轮结果都不同（这轮：车 1 SSH 断/rosbridge 通，车 3 正好相反） |

也就是说：**这个 AP 把无线客户端之间的 UDP 和组播隔开了**（典型的 AP 客户端隔离 / IGMP snooping），而 DDS 恰好依赖它们。TCP 能过，所以之前用板子驱动小车、语音控制都正常——那条路是点对点 TCP。

## 两条可选路线

**一、把网络接通（推荐）。** 四台车的 `eth0` 都在、只是没插线：

```
eth0: DOWN  <NO-CARRIER>     ← 没接网线
wlan0: UP   192.168.1.20x    ← 现在全靠 WiFi
```

找个小交换机，把四台车（和板子）用网线插上，编队栈就能按设计跑。顺带把车 1、车 4 的电充满——编队行驶耗电很快，电量低会像车 1 这样重启。

**二、改成板子集中控制。** 板子对每台车单独走 TCP（rosbridge），自己算队形目标、逐车下发速度，绕开跨车 DDS。这条路现在就能用，但有两个前提要先确认：链路断掉时底盘会不会自动停（cmd_vel 看门狗，我还没验证到，因为网络查不下去），以及四台车的 rosbridge 要同时稳定在线。

网络一通，编队我可以直接一键跑：`enable_formation_agent.sh` → `arm_command_bridge.sh`（限时租约，最多 30 秒）→ `formation_once.py --execute`，队形（square/line/circle/diamond）、间距、时长都是参数。

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""cmd_vel 看门狗 —— 指令停了就自动停车。
+
+背景：厂商的 odom_publisher_node 收到一条 cmd_vel 就直接下发一次电机指令，
+**没有超时逻辑**。所以发指令的一方（遥控/脚本/语音助手/网络）一旦中断，
+车会保持最后的速度一直跑下去 —— 这就是"运动不会自动停下"。
+
+做法（不改厂商代码）：
+  订阅厂商的三个速度入口 /controller/cmd_vel、/cmd_vel、/app/cmd_vel，
+  只要 TIMEOUT 秒内没有新指令、且最后一次指令不是零速，就往
+  /controller/cmd_vel 发一条零速度，由厂商节点转成电机停止。
+
+  只发一次，避免刷屏；有新指令进来就重新计时。
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+
+import rclpy
+from geometry_msgs.msg import Twist
+
+TIMEOUT = 0.5      # 秒：超过这么久没有新指令就停车
+HZ = 20.0          # 检查频率
+TOPICS = ("/controller/cmd_vel", "/cmd_vel", "/app/cmd_vel")
+
+
+class Watchdog:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.node = rclpy.create_node("cmd_vel_watchdog")
+        self.pub = self.node.create_publisher(Twist, "/controller/cmd_vel", 10)
+        for topic in TOPICS:
+            self.node.create_subscription(Twist, topic, self.on_cmd, 10)
+        self.last_rx = 0.0
+        self.moving = False
+        self.stops = 0
+        self.node.create_timer(1.0 / HZ, self.tick)
+        self.node.get_logger().info(
+            "cmd_vel 看门狗已启动：%.1f 秒没有新指令就发零速度停车" % TIMEOUT)
+
+    def on_cmd(self, msg: Twist) -> None:
+        self.last_rx = time.monotonic()
+        self.moving = (abs(msg.linear.x) > 1e-3 or abs(msg.linear.y) > 1e-3
+                       or abs(msg.angular.z) > 1e-3)
+
+    def tick(self) -> None:
+        if self.last_rx == 0.0 or not self.moving:
+            return
+        age = time.monotonic() - self.last_rx
+        if age > TIMEOUT:
+            self.pub.publish(Twist())      # 全零 = 停
+            self.moving = False
+            self.stops += 1
+            self.node.get_logger().warn(
+                "指令中断 %.1f 秒，已发零速度停车（累计 %d 次）" % (age, self.stops))
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    rclpy.init()
+    watchdog = Watchdog()
+    try:
+        rclpy.spin(watchdog.node)
+    except KeyboardInterrupt:
+        pass
+    finally:
+        watchdog.node.destroy_node()
+        rclpy.shutdown()
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
